description: Account A/B isolation plus book-delete propagation/persistence contract red-baseline target for ACT-ACCOUNT-DELETE-PERSISTENCE-CONTRACTS PR-1.

account-delete-persistence.description: Live, non-mocked account A/B isolation and book-delete propagation/persistence baseline. Green evidence requires QA A/B accounts, disposable book fixtures, SQL verification, and R2/storage audit.
account-delete-persistence.defaultExpectedOutcome: Account/book-delete/persistence behavior should match ACCT/DEL/PAR contracts in docs/testing/everything-current-state-and-qa-baseline.md.

ACCT-001/ACCT-002/ACCT-003 captures env-.expected: Account A/B switching proves no cross-account library/cache/outbox artifact leakage and A return integrity through live UI/session evidence.

DEL-001/DEL-002 captures env-blocked boo.expected: Book delete proof requires a disposable book fixture, server-authoritative books.deleted_at, and owned R2/file storage removal or tombstone evidence.

DEL-003/DEL-004/DEL-005/DEL-006 captures.expected: Book delete tombstones propagate cross-device, survive offline/reload/logout/account-switch lifecycle, handle legacy/pre-namespace keys, and do not resurrect soft-deleted books.

PAR-001/PAR-002 validates canonical plat.expected: The target is discoverable through the canonical QA CLI and records explicit setup/reset requirements for platform and pre-namespace migration evidence.
